title.en: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
title.zh: Perplexity信任GPT-6 Astra的端到端系统

summary.en: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.
summary.zh: Perplexity使用Astra编写通信、更改软件和监控生产系统，并且与早期型号相比，签入的频率要低得多。

title.en: Cognition helps Devin test its own work with GPT‑6 Astra

summary.en: GPT‑6 Astra improves Devin’s ability to test software and show that it works, with the goal of helping engineers review less code and ship more.
